name: Telekinetic
summary: +1 Int, Wis or Cha; an invisible, silent Mage Hand with 30 more feet of range, and a Bonus Action 5-foot shove.

benefits.name: Minor Telekinesis
benefits.summary: Learn Mage Hand; cast it without Verbal or Somatic components, make the hand Invisible, +30 ft range.
benefits.text: You learn the Mage Hand spell. You can cast it without Verbal or Somatic components, you can make the spectral hand Invisible, and its range increases by 30 feet when you cast it. Its spellcasting ability is the ability you increased with this feat.

benefits.name: Telekinetic Shove
benefits.summary: Bonus Action: a creature within 30 ft makes a Str save (DC 8 + mod + PB) or is moved 5 ft toward or away.
benefits.text: As a Bonus Action, you can telekinetically shove one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 plus the modifier of the ability you increased with this feat and your Proficiency Bonus) or be moved 5 feet toward you or away from you.
